summary: All 6 files in StatsMLlib/Probability/GraphicalModel/ contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, and proofs related to graphical models, conditional independence, Markov properties, factorization, and the Hammersley-Clifford theorem. DiscreteCondIndep.lean defines product-form conditional independence and proves semigraphoid/graphoid axioms. Factorization.lean defines clique factorization and proves it implies the global Markov property. Graphoid.lean defines semigraphoid and graphoid structures axiomatically. HammersleyClifford.lean proves the Hammersley-Clifford theorem and equivalence of factorization with Markov properties for positive distributions. Markov.lean defines global/local/pairwise Markov properties and proves their equivalence for graphoids. Separation.lean provides the purely combinatorial graph separation theory. All files are formal mathematics relevant to search; none are pure imports, build configuration, or documentation-only.
